import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/shop/playerShop/visit/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { appendCurrencyCardToMd } from '@src/utils/currencyCardHelper';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { resolveTargetUidFromArg } from '@src/utils/targetUid';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';
/** 共享导航 */
const SHOP_HEADER = [
  { label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' },
  { label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' },
  { label: '珍宝楼', command: '/珍宝楼' }
];

/**
 * 逛店指令（查看他人店铺）
 * - 指令格式：/逛店 用户UID/@目标 [页码]
 * - 展示该玩家的店铺信息和在售物品
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/逛店\s+(\S+)(?:\s+(\d+))?/);

  if (!m) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请指定店铺：/逛店 用户UID 或 /逛店 @目标');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '逛店',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const targetUid = await resolveTargetUidFromArg(m[1], mention);
  const page = m[2] ? Math.max(1, Number(m[2])) : 1;

  if (!targetUid) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请提供有效的店主UID，或直接 @目标');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '逛店', content: md, footer: [{ label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' }] }));

    return;
  }

  try {
    const result = await App({ bid, uid, targetUid, page, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    if (result.code === 'NO_SHOP') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('该玩家尚未开店');

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '逛店',
          content: md,
          footer: [{ label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '逛店',
          content: md,
          footer: [{ label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const { shop, items: listings, pagination, currencies } = result.data;

    if (!shop) {
      throw new Error('店铺响应缺少店铺信息');
    }
    const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    appendCurrencyCardToMd(contentMd, currencies);

    // 店铺信息头部
    contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`店主：${shop.ownerName}(${shop.levelName})`));

    if (shop.description) {
      contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${shop.description}`));
    }

    contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`热度：${shop.heatScore},成交：${shop.totalSales}笔`));

    // 在售物品列表
    if (listings.length === 0) {
      contentMd.addText('店里暂无物品');
      contentMd.addNewline();
    } else {
      listings.forEach(it => {
        const canBuy = it.canPurchase;
        const typeLabel = it.itemCategoryLabel;

        const lines = [`【${it.listingId}】【${typeLabel}】 ${it.itemName} ×${it.quantity}`];
        const extra = it.attributeView;

        if (extra?.attrText) {
          lines.push(`属性：${extra.attrText}`);
        }
        lines.push(`单价：${it.unitPriceAmount} ${it.currencyName}`);
        contentMd.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown(lines, canBuy ? [{ label: '购买', command: `/选购 ${it.listingId}` }] : []));
      });
    }

    const { currentPage, totalPages } = pagination;
    const footer: { label: string; command: string }[] = [];

    if (currentPage > 1) {
      footer.push({ label: '上一页', command: `/逛店 ${targetUid} ${currentPage - 1}` });
    }

    if (currentPage < totalPages) {
      footer.push({ label: '下一页', command: `/逛店 ${targetUid} ${currentPage + 1}` });
    }

    if (listings.length > 0) {
      contentMd.addText(`第${currentPage}/${totalPages}页`);
    }

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: `逛店 - ${shop.shopName}`,
        header: SHOP_HEADER,
        content: contentMd,
        footer
      })
    );
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('获取店铺信息失败，请稍后再试');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '逛店',
        content: md,
        header: SHOP_HEADER
      })
    );
  }
});
